main_measure.name: mean of -forecast/10 x (10-bar forward return - coin's all-window mean 10-bar return)
main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with t >= 2 to confirm, mean < 0 with t <= -2 to reject, over at least 30 non-overlapping active cases

supporting_check.name: mean 10-bar excess return on top-quartile |forecast| bars, non-overlapping

decided_by: t lies between -2 and 2, which neither confirms nor rejects.
reading: The coin's mean 10-bar return uses every bar of all its windows (within-window returns); the top quartile is |forecast| at or above the 75th percentile over all active bars, then taken on the 0,10,20,... grid; below-average is read from dist200 if recorded, else the 'trending' label; fewer than 30 cases is reported as not observable.
